# Copilot Instructions

The canonical, tool-agnostic instructions for this repository live in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), with detailed guides under [`docs/agents/`](../docs/agents/).

**Before working, read `AGENTS.md` and the relevant guide in `docs/agents/`.**

> Note: GitHub Copilot does not import external files into custom instructions.
> If you rely on Copilot's auto-injected instructions, keep this file in sync with
> `AGENTS.md` (or copy the needed sections here).
